messages:
Avery: Thanks for coming — quick live Q&A on the product roadmap items we skimmed. Focus: API streaming latency, Console per-model billing, and Optimize rollout. Ask quick questions here.

Priya: TL;DR: streaming perf -> targeted alpha in 3 weeks, console metrics beta in ~6 weeks, Optimize quant advisor early preview in Q3. Will post concrete calendar later today.

Jordan: For the console metric beta, can CS see per-customer views so they can help troubleshoot cost spikes?

Priya: Yes — beta includes a per-customer breakdown (token counts + estimated spend) and a "compare" view for two model versions. CS access controlled by role.

Marco: Engineering caveat: streaming alpha depends on the new kernel being on staging by next week. If kernel slips we'd push alpha back 1 week. Canary plan will be in the runbook.

Sam: SDK note: adding streaming helpers and an aborted-stream callback in SDK 1.5. Docs + migration guide will land in the SDK PR.

Eli: How will Dedicated customers opt in? any extra cost or perf SLA changes?

Priya: Dedicated opt-in via Console toggle + API header. No automatic cost change; if you opt into "strict-latency" path we may change instance sizing behind the scenes (we'll surface recommended changes). SLAs unchanged for the beta.

Maya: Optimize question 7: will quant advisor expose an expected quality delta and a rollback URL? we need safe rollbacks for customers.

Marco: Yes opt returns an estimated quality delta with confidence bands, and the rollout UI will expose a one-click rollback to the previous model variant. We'll also attach the eval prompt-set and A/B metrics.

Jordan: Can we get a quick example of the new streaming param?

Sam: Example (draft):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","streaming_mode":"low_latency","input":"Summarize the meeting."}'
```

Avery: Nice. Who's owning the communication plan for customers? need an FAQ + opt-in email template.

Jordan: I'll coordinate with CS & sales on the messaging. Will draft the email by Friday.

Priya: I'll publish the timeline + risk matrix tonight in the roadmap doc (link: https://go.redwood/roadmap-may-july).

Deploy-Bot: New runbook created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/streaming-alpha-canary (owner: Marco)

Marco: I'll post the canary checklist and mitigation steps by EOD tomorrow.

Avery: Recap of action items: Priya publishes timeline, Marco posts runbook, Sam lands SDK PR + docs draft, Jordan drafts customer comms, Eli to pre-check Dedicated opt-in flows with infra. Ping here when started. Closing thread for new questions, will reopen if needed. :wave:
